verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents an `agent` that turns high-level tasks into fully autonomous browser workflows, with configurable models, instructions and max steps [stagehand-docs-28]. It also offers deterministic caching of agent-discovered workflows for repeat runs [stagehand-docs-29], persistent browser data across runs [stagehand-docs-7, stagehand-docs-8], and remote Browserbase sessions with replay dashboards [stagehand-docs-9, stagehand-docs-10]. However, Stagehand is an SDK you invoke from your own code, and nothing in the pack shows it can set up automations that run unattended in the background. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling or triggers for background runs, a managed way to set up recurring automations, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended autonomous operation.
